value.note: The long hall's end chest is walled in stone, so every container the world holds is claimed.

why: The long hall's end chest — the gallery's one scenery container — replaced by stone through a stage-7 batch, with the notice left declared. Every container left is loot, a collect or a device, so the notice would tell the party the town is bare where it is not. It declares no unit: the batch verbs are bound in the primary, and the patch reaches the unanchored cell through the anchor standing on top of it.
